bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'USERBOT_DEPLOY_INSPECTION=START\n'
printf 'CHECKOUT_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'CHECKOUT_BRANCH=%s\n' "$(git branch --show-current)"
printf 'SERVICE_ACTIVE=%s\n' "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service 2>/dev/null || true)"
printf 'SERVICE_ENABLED=%s\n' "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service 2>/dev/null || true)"
for f in scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py scripts/userbot_topic_entry_audit.py scripts/userbot_keepalive.py; do
 if test -f "$f"; then echo "FILE_$(basename "$f")=PRESENT"; else echo "FILE_$(basename "$f")=MISSING"; fi
done
if grep -q '"topic_entry_audit"' scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py 2>/dev/null; then echo 'AUDIT_IPC_SOURCE=YES'; else echo 'AUDIT_IPC_SOURCE=NO'; fi
if test -S deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock; then echo 'IPC_SOCKET=YES'; else echo 'IPC_SOCKET=NO'; fi
printf 'GIT_MODIFIED_TARGET_BEGIN\n'
git status --porcelain -- scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py scripts/userbot_topic_entry_audit.py scripts/userbot_keepalive.py deploy/systemd/gace-userbot-verify.service
printf 'GIT_MODIFIED_TARGET_END\n'
printf 'USERBOT_DEPLOY_INSPECTION=END\n'
